notes: Retrace your steps, share a spot, and a cleaner face. Backtrack: a spoof now remembers where it began, so “drove to the shop, now drive home” is one tap — Back to <place> on the live card and in Places, offered only when there's an origin to return to. Share: every place card gains a Share button beside Teleport and Save, handing off the coordinate and a Maps link. Places, rebuilt: quick actions up top to paste a coordinate, drop a pin or backtrack; saved spots, routes and recents in tidy grouped cards; and a real empty state with a paste shortcut instead of text floating over a void. A live status card in Settings: it opens with the one thing you came to check — spoofing or not, where, and whether the link is holding — with a soft pulse while live. And a redesigned sign-in and onboarding: one deliberate dark world with the pin as the hero and a real, solid button, where the old gate mixed adaptive colours over a fixed gradient and its sign-in button read as disabled. Fixed: tapping a point of interest on the map now drops your pin or a route waypoint instead of popping Apple's own place card (which sometimes even opened Safari); and the VPN link is tidier across reconnects — observers no longer stack up.
